title: An app's resources say what they need
description: Each resource an app brings shows whether it is added, has an update or is no longer offered, and a workflow added before the agent it runs is refused naming that agent, then runs the team's copy once it is added. A name the team already uses is refused with another offered, an update makes a new draft and asks first when the copy was edited, and an agent a workflow runs is kept until that workflow changes.
